text_block_list.text:
Late one night, on the eve of a race. I 
spotted Taiki Shuttle, still running out 
on the darkened track.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Gates, open... Three, two, one...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Get ready... Get set—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Go!

"...Calling out her name went unheard, and 
she dashed off on her own cue."

"She runs, stops, ponders for a moment, 
and runs again. Taiki Shuttle repeats this 
in single-minded focus."

For a while, I watched her run from the 
spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew…… Time's up already! Too bad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm? Could that person over there be... 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching, by any chance? You 
should've called out to me!
choice_data_list:
It looked like you were really 
concentrating, so...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! I only meant to go for a light 
run, but I got totally caught up in it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Running really is so much fun, YES~! Why 
don't you join in too, Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Work up a sweat and refresh yourself! It 
makes the food taste so much better, too!"
choice_data_list: It's already time to head home.
It's already time to head home.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer is here with me, we won't get 
scolded for staying late!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"There's nobody around at this hour, so we 
can run to our heart's content!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So... Trainer, please let me run even 
moooore!
choice_data_list:
You should get some rest to prepare for 
the race...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why, desu."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit was made for victory... It's 
proof of my desire to win, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... when I wear this, my mind and 
body tremble, and scream out loud.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That this is a battle you absolutely 
cannot lose.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since Trainer makes me stronger, 
I've gotten greedy, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm full of the desire not to lose! Please 
take responsibili-ty!
choice_data_list: If it's just a little longer...
Don't worry, I'll make sure you win!
Don't worry, I'll definitely make you win!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm full of the desire not to lose! Please 
take responsibili-ty!
choice_data_list: If it's just a little longer...
Don't worry, I'll make sure you win!
Don't worry, I'll definitely make you win!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Oh, really!? I'm so very happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It is dark already, but... I can still 
run mucho more-o!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A promise, right? Thank you, 
Trainer-san!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then... I promise too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely win. No matter who my 
opponent is, I don't plan on losing.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle

text_block_list.text:
And so, together with Taiki Shuttle, I 
pledged once again to become number one.
